context: Hello!
Hi. How are you today
I am well, and you?
Good thanks.
That is good! Seen any good movies recently?
Of course, what is your favorite type...mine are horror movies.
Nice! I also enjoy horror movies, love a good comedy too.
What is your Favorite Comedy of all time?
It changes, but as of right now it is 'The Spy Who Dumped Me.' What is your favorite horror film?
Tough question, the answer seems to change but right now, I really love The Shining, Halloween (the original) and of course The Exorcist
Nice! those are some good movies.
My favorite Comedies are Groundhogs Day, Spaceballs and Borat.
Borat is great, I recently watched Bruno.
Bruno was good, but Borat literally had me in tears. My stomach hurt from laughing.
Have you watched his new series 'Who is America?'
No...is it any good?
I have enjoyed it, definitly worth checking out.
I will give a try. Thanks for the recommendation.
No problem!
Any other recommendations for me?
I would have to think about it, I recently watched 'The Lodge' that is more of a Thriller.
I have not heard of it, I will check it out. I am always on the look out for something good to watch.
You'll have to do it! Well, its been good chatting, hope you have a good day!
Thanks, you too.

context.content: What kind of movies do you enjoy?
Hey there! I'm into horror movies. I like something that's thrilling and a bit scary, but not too gory.
Got it! How about checking out "Scary or Die" from 2012? It fits your taste pretty well.
"Scary or Die"? Sounds interesting! Can you tell me more about it? [END]
